name: agentic-helpers
description: agentic-memory, the scratch sweep and grounding gate hooks, agentic-capture, and a skill for each

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: openai (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) or ollama; empty turns semantic search off

embedding_model.title: Embedding model
embedding_model.description: The model the endpoint serves, e.g. embeddinggemma-300m-6bit

embedding_endpoint.title: Embedding endpoint
embedding_endpoint.description: Base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1235; empty takes the provider's default

embedding_api_key_env.title: API key variable
embedding_api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding a hosted embedder's key; the key itself is never stored

entry_max_words.title: Entry word limit
entry_max_words.description: Words an entry should stay within; longer entries still land, with a note

state_stale_after_writes.title: File writes before a state hold
state_stale_after_writes.description: File writes since a memory seat's last state write that hold the turn's end once for a new one

retired_body_days.title: Retired body days
retired_body_days.description: Days a retired entry keeps its body before a log merge drops it; at least 14

entry_id_length.title: Entry id length
entry_id_length.description: Characters after m- in a new entry id, 6 to 16; ids already filed keep working

brief_note_limit.title: Brief note limit
brief_note_limit.description: Notes the memory brief prints, hottest first; the rest stay one agentic-memory brief --kind note away

attachment_max_mb.title: Attachment size limit
attachment_max_mb.description: Megabytes one file attached to a memory entry may hold

attachment_budget_mb.title: Attachment budget per project
attachment_budget_mb.description: Megabytes the files attached to a project's memory entries may hold together, each file counted once

memory_require_git.title: Memory only inside git
memory_require_git.description: Keep agentic-memory to git work trees; off lets a directory outside git keep a store keyed by its own path

memory_turns_off_auto.title: Seat claim turns off Claude Code's auto memory
memory_turns_off_auto.description: A seat claim writes autoMemoryEnabled: false into the project's .claude/settings.local.json, from the next session; off leaves the file alone

memory_language.title: Memory entry language
memory_language.description: Locale entries are written in where the project's .sdd/config.yaml names none, e.g. de; empty means en

temporary_seat_lifetime.title: Temporary seat lifetime
temporary_seat_lifetime.description: How long a closed temporary seat keeps its entries before they are purged, e.g. 12h, 1d, 0; empty means 1d

tools_query_floor.title: Tool query floor
tools_query_floor.description: Cosine at or above which agentic-tools counts a tool as near a search or a prompt; depends on the embedder

memory_enabled.title: Switch on agentic-memory
memory_enabled.description: agentic-memory: seats, entries, recall and their hooks; off, its commands refuse and its hooks say nothing

tools_enabled.title: Switch on agentic-tools
tools_enabled.description: agentic-tools: the helper tool library and its hooks; off, its commands refuse and its hooks say nothing

scratch_enabled.title: Switch on the scratch sweep
scratch_enabled.description: agentic-scratch: sweeping .tmp/claude/<session>/ at session end; off, shell-guard's mktemp ban goes off with it

grounding_gate_enabled.title: Switch on the grounding gate
grounding_gate_enabled.description: agentic-grounding-gate: the sdd reads owed before a question, draft or capture; off, agentic-capture goes off with it

capture_enabled.title: Switch on agentic-capture
capture_enabled.description: agentic-capture: capturing sdd entries from drafts; off, it refuses

shell_guard_enabled.title: Switch on shell-guard
shell_guard_enabled.description: agentic-shell-guard: holding Bash removals to the project and banning mktemp; off, every Bash call runs unjudged

shell_guard_outside_project.title: Shell-guard: removals outside the project
shell_guard_outside_project.description: ask, deny or off for an rm, rmdir, unlink or git rm reaching outside the project and /tmp, or a command whose name is not fixed text, passed arguments or able to split into words (an ask there refuses twice per session first); empty means ask

shell_guard_find_delete.title: Shell-guard: find -delete
shell_guard_find_delete.description: ask, deny or off for find ... -delete; empty means ask

shell_guard_lone_removal.title: Shell-guard: removals run alone
shell_guard_lone_removal.description: Deny a removal that is not the whole Bash command: no other statement, pipe, redirection, subshell or wrapper

shell_guard_expansion.title: Shell-guard: literal removal targets
shell_guard_expansion.description: Deny a removal whose target is built from a variable or command substitution

shell_guard_nested_code.title: Shell-guard: nested code
shell_guard_nested_code.description: Deny a removal or mktemp inside eval, a shell's -c, or inline code for another interpreter

shell_guard_mktemp.title: Shell-guard: mktemp
shell_guard_mktemp.description: Deny mktemp anywhere in a Bash command; scratch files go under the project's .tmp/

shell_guard_secrets.title: Shell-guard: credentials in a command
shell_guard_secrets.description: ask, deny or off for a Bash command holding what looks like a credential (a token, a key); an ask refuses twice per session first, so the agent can rewrite it; empty means ask

shell_guard_secret_output.title: Shell-guard: credentials in tool output
shell_guard_secret_output.description: all, files or off: withhold each line looking like a credential from tool output that comes from outside the project; files limits it to Read, Grep, NotebookRead, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Bash; empty means all

shell_guard_secret_output_skip.title: Shell-guard: tools whose output is never withheld
shell_guard_secret_output_skip.description: Comma-separated tool names or patterns, e.g. WebFetch, mcp__sdd__*; empty means none

shell_guard_ask_timeout.title: Shell-guard: ask countdown
shell_guard_ask_timeout.description: Seconds a shell-guard ask waits for an answer in auto and bypassPermissions mode before it denies, at most 3600; 0 waits without limit

tools_duplicate_floor.title: Tool duplicate floor
tools_duplicate_floor.description: Cosine at or above which agentic-tools refuses a new tool's description as another tool's, unless --distinct says how it differs
